notes.title: Version 0.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Innovations[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Added learning level[/b][/h3]
[*] [b][u]Non-editable world templates[/u][/b]
[i]Not all world templates can now be completely edited and their generation system can be changed[/i]
[*] [u][b]Extended hints of slots with items[/b][/u]
[*] [b][u]Description of some items[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Hint button[/u][/b]
[i]Appears to the right of the text input field in the chat for some commands: /give, /effect, /setObject, /summon[/i]
[*] [b][u]The ability to extract resin from wood[/u][/b]
[i]To do this, pick up a knife, go to the tree, [b]right-click[/b] on the object and with a probability of [b]40% [/b] you will get resin. The largest tree [b] has the maximum number of attempts equal to 6[/b].[/i]
[*] [b][u]Game rule "One life"[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Command /setObject[/u][/b]
[i]Allows you to place objects in the world[/i]
[*] [b][u]System of broken things[/u][/b]
[i]If the strength of the item has dropped to 1 unit, then the item becomes broken and its functionality is lost. You can fix it on the anvil using the resources to fix it.[/i]
[*] [b][u]Ability to create chains of commands[/u][/b]
[i]Example: /command;/command;/command... and so on[/i]
[*] [b][u]Command /summon[/u][/b]
[i]Allows you to summon an entity[/i]
[*] [b][u]Throwing a snowball into the fire - its burning time will decrease[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u] GorenjeA bucket of water can be filled with drops from the dropper[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]A bucket of water can put out the fire[/u][/b]
[i]If you put out a small fire with a bucket of water, it will not disappear and it can be lit again [/i]
[*] [b][u]The inscription of the selected item in the hand above the quick access panel[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Jetpack now loses strength during flight[/u][/b]
[i]Like other items that lose their strength, it can be repaired on an anvil using an iron ingot[/i]
[*] [b][u]Snow and eggs can now be thrown by holding them in your hand[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Apples now appear on trees[/u][/b]
[i]The size of the tree depends on the number of apples that can grow on it randomly[/i]
[*] [b][u]Added wooden hoe[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]You can water the beds with a bucket of water[/u][/b]
[i]When watering the bed, the growth rate is doubled until the next stage of growth [/i]
[/list]

[h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Some objects in my hand now emit light and particles[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]The Russian translation[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u] has been redoneThe system of loosening the bed[/u][/b]
[i]Now to create a garden bed, there must be land in the inventory [/i]
[*] [b][u]Bushes with red berries now appear in the "Creepy Forest" world template[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Placement of objects[/u][/b]
[i]In order [b] to place[/b] an object, now you need [b]to hold down and hold the right mouse button[/b]. [b]To cancel[/b] the placement of the object - press [b]the left mouse button[/b][/i]
[*] [b][u]A bucket of water needs to be poured into the boiler to start cooking[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]The shadow at night is now slightly lighter[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Changed the camera control in the note book[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Completely changed the control of a player with a jetpack on [/u][/b]
[i]After placing the jetpack in the bib slot, press the space bar twice and you will start flying. To stop flying, press the space bar again 2 times.[/i]
[/list]

[h2][b]Error correction[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The player's stamina was spent when pressing Left Shift even if the player was standing still
[*] The player's stats displayed his statuses incorrectly
[*] The buttons on the death screen displayed an incorrect translation
[*] The boiler had no cooking functionality and its interaction panel did not open correctly
[*] When creating items, the crafting window did not see items in the Quick access toolbar
[*] It was not possible to pick up eggs from the nest with the right mouse button
[*] No torches appeared in crafting recipes
[/list]
